themes.evidence: We offer a rapidly changing assortment of brand name, designer and other high-quality merchandise at prices generally 20%-60% below department and specialty store regular prices on comparable merchandise, every day.
We see ourselves as leaders in innovation, constantly testing new ideas, seeking the right categories, current fashions and top brands, and leveraging information from our worldwide buying presence.
In our 40-year history, we have delivered steady sales and earnings growth and some of the highest returns on investment we have seen in retail.
